_comment: Fixture for TC-019 / TC-020. Copy this file to tools/manual-test-ui/projects.json
of the project under test, then replace both paths below with real absolute
paths on this machine. Each path must be a directory that contains docs/issues/;
one of them is this project, the other is any second project. The names may stay
as they are — they are what the project selector shows. Keys starting with _ are
ignored by the tool. Alternative to explicit entries: "projectRoots": ["/path/to/dev"]
auto-discovers every subdirectory one level deep that has docs/issues/.
